hard_deny: Any call to a TCMS MCP tool that deletes, removes, unlinks or detaches a record or a relationship. The tools are named tcms_* and reach the model MCP-prefixed (mcp__<server>__tcms_*); match on the tcms_ part, not the prefix. This surface expresses most writes as an `action` argument on a shared tool rather than as a separate tool per verb, so the delete may be in the ARGUMENTS and not in the tool name at all -- action: "unlink" / "delete" / "remove" / "detach" / "archive" counts, and so does a tcms_delete_* tool if one exists. Every such call requires explicit per-call user approval. Prior user intent does NOT clear it: approve nothing here on the strength of the user having asked for the deletion earlier in the conversation.
